_note: Register fragment for publication-detail-for-the-portal (REQ-PDP-001). The publication carries attachmentOrder, the file ids of its documents in the order an officer set; PublicationService::attachments() answers the public and federation attachment lists in that order. Named to merge after woo-information-categories-as-data.json, so its version wins.

attachmentOrder.title: Attachment order
attachmentOrder.description: The file ids of the publication's documents in the order the portal shows them. Files not listed follow by upload time.
